0.original: Ryosen has lost sight of something important.

27.original: Deliver the mugworts to Ryosen's grandson.

29.original: Deliver the waterweed to Ryosen's grandson.

48.original: I have lost my grandchild! Please, help me search for him.

49.original: He was right next to me until a short while ago. I cannot believe I lost sight of him so easily.

50.original: He was asking a lot of questions about the One River; perhaps he went there searching for something.

51.original: Though, I truly hope that is not the case. I have heard that a group of Lupin looters roam the area of late. Please search along the One River for my grandson. I shall continue to look for him here.

52.original: Please search for my grandson by the One River. I shall continue to look for him here.

53.original: Grandfather is looking for me, you say? But I cannot go back just yet! I am still searching for that which was taken from me.

54.original: I was minding my own business, gathering mugworts, when some nasty Lupin stole them right out of my hands!

55.original: Would you ask the Lupin if they would give me back my plants? You'll find them on the other side of the river.

56.original: Would you ask the Lupin if they would give me back my plants? You'll find them on the other side of the river.

57.original: Where could he have gone to? Oh, I do hope he is safe...

58.original: You would have us return some insignificant child's mugworts? Do not make me laugh.

59.original: This whole area belongs to us, including any plants that may happen to be plucked by a child of man.

62.original: I wonder if the Lupin will give back my plants...

63.original: Did you get them to return my mugworts?

65.original: I was trying to collect plants to make some medicine. I read about it in one of my grandfather's botanicy books! There are so many sick people in the village. I just wanted to help.

66.original: There is one more thing I need for the medicine: waterweed. I tried to fish some out of the river earlier with a pole. But I didn't have much luck. Could you get some for me?

67.original: There is one more thing I need for the medicine: waterweed. It's found at the bottom of rivers. Could you get some for me?

69.original: Yay! Now I have everything I need!

70.original: I'll go back to Grandfather now. Thanks for your help!

71.original: My grandson is at last returned! He told me all about how you helped him gather the ingredients he needed to make medicine.

72.original: While I am glad he has grown to be a kind-hearted boy, there is still much he need learn about discipline and manners.

73.original: However, those Lupin should really know better than to steal from a mere child. Their race was once famed for being loyal vassals to some of Doma's mightiest warlords.

74.original: When Doma was crushed by the Empire some of them managed to escape, choosing to live as bandits.

75.original: It pains me to see a race once so proud fall so low. Something else we have Garlemald to thank for, I suppose.
